requirements: R1: Measure the percentage of closed tasks that have verifiable git merge evidence on the main branch to ensure delivery integrity

slices.title: Instrument code delivery integrity measurement
slices.jtbd: When implementing measurement for this epic, I want to query the task repository against git history, so that stakeholders can trust the delivery metrics.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a set of closed tasks in the system
When the delivery integrity metric is computed
Then it accurately reports the ratio of closed tasks with actual merge evidence
Given the computed metric
When a stakeholder views the delivery report
Then the metric is clearly displayed with deterministic dummy data
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase the accuracy of delivery progress reporting to 100%

slices.title: Verify delivery integrity measurement
slices.jtbd: When testing this epic, I want to verify the measurement accurately tracks git evidence, so that stakeholders aren't misinformed by broken metrics.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a repository with mixed phantom and real deliveries
When the integrity metric is queried
Then it reports exactly the expected verifiable ratio
Given the delivery report view
When a stakeholder accesses the dashboard
Then the metric updates correctly without error
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the defect escape rate from 1 to 0 for the delivery reporting feature
